findings.title: CHANGELOG.md not updated for bugfix commits with user-visible behavior change
findings.claim: Both commits are bugfixes with user-visible behaviour change and neither touches a changelog, per CONTRIBUTING.md's checklist; however CHANGELOG.md doesn't exist in this fork, so repo practice has already retired the rule.

findings.title: Functional change to getCassandraLongType lacks godoc per CONTRIBUTING checklist
findings.claim: helpers.go:280-284 changes what getCassandraLongType returns for an unrecognised basic type, which leaks into every TypeInfo consumer's String()/error text, but has no godoc; deemed acceptable since it's unexported and has an inline comment explaining why.

findings.title: Commit messages don't follow CONTRIBUTING.md's capitalized subject + Patch-by/reviewed-by trailer format
findings.claim: CONTRIBUTING.md documents a capitalized short description plus a 'Patch by …; reviewed by …' trailer, but these commits use lowercase conventional-commit subjects with no such trailer; not a violation since every commit on main does the same.

findings.title: Commits and PR body carry Claude attribution trailers violating the user's global no-attribution rule
findings.claim: Both commits carry a Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 trailer and the PR body ends with a '🤖 Generated with Claude Code' line; the user's global rule forbids both, so they should be stripped.

findings.title: Duplicated 'if info.Dimensions > 0 && data != nil' guard with different bodies
findings.claim: marshal.go:996 and marshal.go:1005 both contain 'if info.Dimensions > 0 && data != nil {' back to back with different bodies and separate explanatory comments; folding them would cost the ordering argument, so it's defensible, but the repetition is the first thing a reader trips on.

findings.title: vectorElemMinSize is a third function branching on vector element type
findings.claim: vectorElemMinSize branches on vector element type like vectorFixedElemSize and isVectorVariableLengthType, and calls both plus its own type assertion, so a new element type must be added in three places; consistent with existing file style, so low priority.

findings.title: math.MaxInt32 saturation sentinel returned as plain int with no type distinction
findings.claim: return math.MaxInt32 at marshal.go:1134 is a saturation sentinel returned as a plain int size; only the comment distinguishes 'huge' from 'measured'.

findings.title: Zero or negative inner vector dimension defeats the allocation bound, restoring 24x amplification
findings.claim: vectorElemMinSize only adds the nested vector's size when vec.Dimensions > 0 and otherwise floors at 1; for vector<vector<float,0>,N> (or a negative inner dimension), elemMin is 1, the bound at marshal.go:997-1001 permits N == len(data), and reflect.MakeSlice takes the peer's whole count — confirmed empirically at 24.0x amplification (25,175,696 bytes for a 1 MiB payload), defeating the PR's headline claim.

findings.title: getCassandraLongType naming fix doesn't cover nested-vector element type in error messages
findings.claim: helpers.go:280-284 only fixes the unknown-basic-type case; the inner VectorType still carries the bare custom name and has no String(), so the nested-vector error path prints 'no Go type for element type custom(...VectorType)' without element type or dimensions, and the new test only checks the message prefix so it doesn't catch this.

findings.title: PR's claim that every new test fails against pristine code is overstated
findings.claim: Replaying the new test file onto main shows TestUnmarshalVectorAcceptsWellFormedPayloads and TestUnmarshalVectorZeroDimensionsDoesNotTouchSubType both pass on main, and TestVectorElemMinSize doesn't compile there; only three of five tests actually fail as claimed.

findings.title: info.Dimensions < 0 check added but undeclared in PR's Scope-In bullets
findings.claim: The info.Dimensions < 0 check at marshal.go:991 is not covered by any Scope-In bullet in the spec, which defers dim < 1 handling to issue #1093; defensible since it avoids a MakeSlice negative-len panic, but it's undeclared scope creep.

findings.title: Bound placement relative to Dimensions consumers checked for wrap-around
findings.claim: The bound was checked to precede every Dimensions consumer in unmarshalVector, including both float fast paths, making Dimensions*8/*4 non-wrapping.

findings.title: getCassandraLongType return-type change confirmed naming-only, no behavioral impact
findings.claim: The helpers.go return-type change was checked and found to be naming-only: NewCustomType returns the same concrete NativeType, and Custom() is read in exactly two places, both requiring a VectorType( prefix the new branch can never produce because helpers.go:261 matches first.

findings.title: vectorElemMinSize saturation arithmetic and division checked for panic risk
findings.claim: vectorElemMinSize's saturation arithmetic was checked and found sound; per is always >= 1, so the division cannot panic.

findings.title: Full test suite passes aside from pre-existing unrelated TLS certificate failures
findings.claim: Full -tags unit suite passes apart from pre-existing TLS failures ('Failed parsing or appending certs') because testdata/pki/generate_certs.sh was never run in this checkout; unrelated to the diff.
